items.label: AS
items.why: The boot program LOAD"AS",8,1 runs: it loads GM1 and jumps to it.

items.label: GM1
items.why: The loader: asks about the fast loader, loads TLD8, TLD7, TLD6, TLD1 and the rest, decrypts TLD1 with the key TLD8 returns ($813E), and carries the text 'PROTECTION GRAEME ASHTON 87'.

items.label: TLD1
items.why: The program, stored encrypted: the loader decrypts it in place at $0400-$43E8, giving packed screens 3 and 4 ($0200 after init_machine's copy, $0C19), the game's code from $1100 and the start of screen 3 at $4000.

items.label: TLD4
items.why: Loaded at $8D00: init_machine copies its first 4 KB ($8D00-$9CFF) to $D000 under the I/O chips, where they are packed screens 2, 5 and 6; the Huffman tree ($9D00-$9FFF) and the music driver's first KB ($A000-$A3FF) stay where they load.

items.label: TLD6
items.why: The loading picture's colours, loaded straight into colour RAM at $D800.

items.label: TLD7
items.why: The loading picture's bitmap and screen, shown while the game loads and loaded over by play.

items.label: TLD8
items.why: A routine the loader calls first at $C800; its answer is the key for decrypting TLD1.

items.label: track 1, sectors 0-20
items.why: Freshly formatted sectors that the disk's map marks used: each holds the 1541's format fill ($4B, or $00 on track 1, then $01 bytes) and nothing else, and the loader asks for every file by name.
